description: This file contains unit tests for the DynamoDB membership table implementation in Orleans, focusing on AWS DynamoDB integration. It defines a test class with multiple test cases verifying membership table operations such as insert, read, update, and cleanup.

classes.name: DynamoDBMembershipTableTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DynamoDB membership table integration, inheriting from MembershipTableTestsBase and implementing tests for AWS DynamoDB storage.
